Record Class TradeRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.dbtraining.reconx.dto.TradeRequest
public record TradeRequest(@NotNull @Pattern(regexp="^[A-Z]{3}-\\d{8}-\\d{4}$",message="tradeRef must match AAA-YYYYMMDD-NNNN") String tradeRef, @NotNull Long instrumentId, @NotNull Long counterpartyId, @NotBlank String assetClass, @NotBlank @Pattern(regexp="^(BUY|SELL)$") String side, @NotNull @Positive BigDecimal quantity, @NotNull @PositiveOrZero BigDecimal price, @NotNull LocalDate tradeDate) extends Record
============================================================================ TradeRequest DTO (POST body) JSR-380 validation annotations live on the DTO, not the entity WHY: Putting @Pattern/@Positive/@NotNull on the JPA entity couples persistence to wire format. The DTO is the wire contract; validate it before mapping. ============================================================================

      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
